name: ai-dlc
description: An agentic engineering team that runs the AI-DLC: 15 role-scoped agents (orchestrator, product owner, product, requirements, architecture, system design, engineering, SQA, review, docs, presentations, critique, research, DevOps, agent management), the full AI-DLC lifecycle (idea to release) plus eight named lifecycles, artifact handoffs and hard quality gates. Each project can customise the workflow (stages, hand-offs, gates and approvers, routing) in .ai-dlc/workflow.json. .NET and JS / TS (Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript) are supported: init installs the stack's rules and test gate in .NET and Node.js repos; more languages will follow.

thresholdPercent.title: Auto-handoff: handoff threshold (% of the context window)
thresholdPercent.description: Share of the context window, 1 to 100, that triggers an automatic session handoff (Claude Code only; main or lead session only, never subagents or teammates). The window is the one Claude Code reports for the session, or 500000 tokens when it reports none. In that case, if the real window is smaller than the line (at the default 80%, a line of 400000 tokens), no handoff fires, so set AUTO_HANDOFF_TOKENS, an absolute token count that overrides this. A seeded session hands off no sooner than 40k past its starting size; the panel above the prompt says so when this leaves less than 40k above the new session's starting size.

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.title: Auto-handoff: handoffs in a row without a message
maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Handoffs allowed before you type a prompt. Past this, auto-handoff pauses until you send one.

briefTemplate.title: Auto-handoff: brief template file
briefTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells Haiku which sections to write. Created with the defaults on first run; edit it to change the brief.

instructionsTemplate.title: Auto-handoff: instructions template file
instructionsTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells the fresh session how to read the brief. Created with the defaults on first run.

ignoreFiles.title: Auto-handoff: ignored files (regex)
ignoreFiles.description: Edited files matching this pattern are left out of the brief, such as auto-synced state or caches. Leave blank for none.

viewer.title: Auto-handoff: viewer address
viewer.description: Where auto-handoff serves a readable page for each brief, as host:port. "tailscale" as the host means this machine's Tailscale IP, so only your tailnet can open it; without Tailscale it serves on 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for no server; the link is then the local file.
